references.text: Here a curse is pronounced over those who do not uphold the law, which mirrors the direct curse (ἐπάρατοί) upon the people who do not know the law in John 7:49.
The book of Moses lists curses that follow from not listening to God's word, a theme underlying the claim that the people are cursed due to their ignorance of the law.
The prophet describes the people as going astray because they do not know God's plan, a direct parallel to the description of the people who do not know the law in John 7:49.
Here the prophet asks who gave Jacob to plunder and Israel to robbers, because they did not listen to God's word, underscoring the consequence of not knowing the law.
Jesus laments that Jerusalem did not know what leads to peace, a thematic link to the people who do not know the law and are thus in spiritual danger.
